entityName: Instytut Genetyki Człowieka Polskiej Akademii Nauk
entityDescription:
The Institute of Human Genetics, Polish Academy of Sciences (IHG PAS) was founded in 1974, and until 2003 operated under the name of the Department of Human Genetics, PAS.
The Institute has the right to confer doctoral degrees (since 2002) and habilitations (since 2010) in the field of medical sciences in the discipline of medical biology and postdoctoral medical sciences in the discipline of medical biology.
The Institute is the leading centre for human genetics research in Poland and a valued partner in scientific cooperation with many institutions in the country and abroad.
The main research areas of the Institute include molecular genetics, cytogenetics, cellular pathology, cancer genetics, and reproductive biology. In recent years, the Institute has also been developing innovative fields such as transgenesis, epigenetics, genomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics. The genetic research conducted at the Institute not only focuses on expanding fundamental knowledge but also finds practical applications in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases through extensive collaboration with medical institutions.

entityDescription:
AO Research Institute Davos is a foundation that contributes to high quality applied preclinical research and development (exploratory and translational) focused towards clinical applications/solutions.
- Investigate and improve the performance of surgical procedures, devices, and substances.
- Foster a close relationship with the AO medical community, academic societies, and universities.
- Provide research environment/support for AO clinicians.
All AO Research Institute Davos projects are applied preclinical research or applied preclinical development projects focused towards clinical applications. Definitions (within the applied research):
- Exploratory applied preclinical research is fundamental research, to solve major clinical problems over an extended timeframe (over ten years).
- Translational applied preclinical research aims at developing a clinical applicable result in around five years and builds upon the fundamental applied preclinical research. This research is usually not possible without the previous fundamental applied preclinical research.

entityDescription:
NEXOFAB™ is a cutting-edge clean-tech and deep-tech company specializing in the development of sustainable, high-performance building systems for a variety of industries, including construction, defense, and aerospace. Our innovative approach combines advanced manufacturing technologies like LSAM (Large Scale Additive Manufacturing), FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling), and CFAM (Continuous Fiber Additive Manufacturing) to produce efficient, eco-friendly building components and solutions.
At the core of NEXOFAB™'s mission is the creation of modular, energy-efficient, and scalable structures that contribute to the reduction of CO2 emissions, reduce material waste, and optimize production processes. Our focus is on enhancing the construction industry’s sustainability and performance by offering lightweight, customizable, and cost-effective solutions that meet the demands of both temporary and permanent structures.
Through the use of LSAM, we are able to create large-scale parts with exceptional precision and scalability. FDM is employed for rapid prototyping and small-scale production, enabling quick iteration and testing of complex designs. Additionally, CFAM integrates continuous fibers into the additive manufacturing process, providing superior strength, durability, and performance in parts for high-demand applications.
NEXOFAB™ is committed to revolutionizing the way we build, utilizing advanced technologies and innovative materials to deliver scalable, energy-efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions. With a focus on both R&D and market expansion, we aim to lead the transition to a more sustainable future in the built environment, defense, and aerospace sectors.

AstaZero AB is a leading research facility in the field of automated and connected transport systems, operating a full-scale independent test environment for future automated transport systems. Additionally, we conduct accredited testing for UNECE requirements and Euro NCAP active safety rating tests, including AD grading and truck testing.

entityDescription:
Cesbio is a public research laboratory which aims to better understand the functioning of continental surfaces and their interactions with climate and humans. Remote sensing is heavily used by Cesbio scientists to monitor the evolution of the planet at various scales and develop models to tackle societal challenges on biodiversity, climate change, food security, water resources, etc. The laboratory also contributes to the development and promotion of Earth Observation by participating in the definition, implementation and scientific exploitation of space missions.
CESBIO is a joint research unit with:
- National Centre for Space Studies (CNES)
- National Center for Scientific Research (CNRS)
- Research Institute for Development (IRD)
- University Toulouse 3 Paul Sabatier (UT3)
- National Institute of Research for agriculture, food and environment (INRAE)
CESBIO is part of the Midi Pyrénées Observatory.
